caveats: Students admitted via school-based admission are exempted from taking CIVL 1000. -- an exemption, not a requirement; it is not applied automatically.
CIVL 4910 OR CIVL 4920 -- (Students taking the Research Option must take CIVL 4920)

CIVL (Environmental) Electives [3 courses from the specified elective list. At least 2 courses (6 credits) should be selected from the "Restricted Electives", of which 1 course must be taken from CIVL 4450, CIVL 5450 or CIVL 5460.] -- the list also admits any CIVL/SENG course, so the credits are checked but the number of courses is not. Confirm the count with your advisor.

Students with CGA of 3.15 or above may apply for enrollment in the Research Option. They should declare their intention to enroll in the Option no later than the first term of their third year of study. In addition, students should take CIVL 4920 as specified in the major requirements.
COMP 1022P: The course was last offered in 2024-25 and was deleted subsequently.
Engineering Fundamental Course(s): COMP 1022P is named in the requirement PDF but not in the 2026-27 course catalog, so it was left out of this check.
